tickets.title: The acknowledgement is admitted at the decision's time (**amendment 9, 2026-10-20**)

authority.requirement: see amendment 9 section 2, ticket P69 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: A shopper whose device clock lags the engine's keeps every viewable impression: the acknowledgement is admitted at the decision's time instead of being refused. A click or dwell stamped by a device lagging more than the decision-to-engagement time still earns no credit (the engagement's own time is bounded only from above; the learning policy credits an engagement only at or after its exposure): that residual is on the amendment list (R-P188).

criteria.observable: On both hosts, a render acknowledgement whose client timestamp is earlier than the decision's engine time (150 ms behind, sent the moment the snapshot answers) is admitted (200, source durable or pending) with admitted.at and the behaviour record's time equal to the decision's time; today: 401 Shopper session unavailable, no row.
criteria.proof: The P69 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P69.AK1 in src/units/P69 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: a client clock ahead is clamped to the engine's present (W23); a same-id re-send answers recovered with one row and one exposure (P57); rendered.at >= ts on every ledger row; the other P56 AA4 refusals (unknown decision, another shopper's decision, outside the window) unchanged; no new remote call before the answer under the latency lever.
criteria.proof: The P69 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P69.AK2 in src/units/P69 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts.

existingEvidence.description: Reproduced locally at five shas (20/20 refused with the client 150 ms behind); hosted refusals follow the walker clock's lag hour by hour; the fix sketched (0 refusals, rendered.at = ts, P57 17/17, AA2 green, AA4 :434 RED as the expected R10).

remainingWork: Drop the client-before-decision refusal at renderOffer.ts:102; admit a first delivery at max(event.timestamp, record.ts) at :118; kit 02 :933 sentence; the specification updates P56 AA4's :434 variant (R10, test-only).

decisions.authorityRef: R-P171 under the owner's standing rule R-P78 (told, not asked)
decisions.effect: The clamp (the lower bound matching W23's upper bound) is the fix; no SDK-only fix because old bundles stay in use.

tickets.title: The statistics object stays warm for the witness (**amendment 9, 2026-10-20; re-scoped by R-P191**)

authority.locator: P70 · section 2 of amendment 9 (re-scoped by R-P191); LIFT-EDGE §2, §5(v)
authority.requirement: see amendment 9 section 2, ticket P70 (copied verbatim in the specification)

tickets.outcome: A learned lift confirmed on the statistics object is served on the deployed hosts on the decisions that follow within ten minutes of the placement's last touch, because the object keeps itself warm with a bounded heartbeat instead of being woken by the shopper's decision; the first decision after a longer quiet spell is still late and says so.

criteria.observable: On both hosts, after a witness call, an exposure write or a credit write, the statistics object holds an alarm due within WARM_HEARTBEAT_MS (about 5 s) and keeps re-arming it until WARM_TAIL_MS (about 10 minutes) after the last touch; a heartbeat alarm publishes nothing and writes no key; after the tail the heartbeats stop (today: the alarm is armed only 30 s ahead by a write and the object is idle between).
criteria.proof: The P70 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P70.WB1 in src/units/P70 and they pass.

criteria.observable: Locks: the single alarm is shared (next due = min of the heartbeat, the publication due at PUBLISH_DELAY_MS, the effect expiry): the 30 s publication timing and the effect-expiry order unchanged; P63 NR1–NR3, P42 PW2, W27 R4, P62 LW1–LW4 and W38 B7 unchanged; the default budgets stay 200 ms and sources.budgets reports them; no new remote call before any answer; the kit states the heartbeat, its bounds and its cost.
criteria.proof: The P70 acceptance command runs the tests named unit:P70.WB2 in src/units/P70 and they pass.

criteria.observable: The released artifact shows the behaviour of every LOCAL criterion on both deployed shopper hosts: the §2 probe at 75 s and at 300 s spacing serves the lift on every reader inside the tail.

existingEvidence.ref: _evidence/baseline-52/lift-edge/ANALYSIS.md (track-analyst at 371bfca8); lanes/L9 and L10 reports and probes
existingEvidence.description: Eviction after about 13–17 s of idleness; served 40/41 under 13 s idle, 0/51 at 17 s or more; the object's own first-call work small; the budget route cannot be computed (every cold read censored) and costs every cold answer; keep-warm ranked first (no authority change).

remainingWork: Record the touch and arm the shared alarm within WARM_HEARTBEAT_MS for WARM_TAIL_MS (LearnStats.ts: arm, alarmScoped, the witness door); the heartbeat branch publishes nothing; kit 02/03; the pair's 600 ms override removed at the next release.

decisions.authorityRef: R-P191 under the owner's standing rule R-P78 (told, not asked)
decisions.effect: The keep-warm heartbeat is the fix; its cost (up to 720 alarm invocations per object-hour inside the tail, the object resident for the tail) is told to the owner; the KV witness record stays listed as the long-quiet-spell shape pending an authority ruling.

tickets.title: The object host's buffered re-decision fires (**amendment 9, 2026-10-20**)

criteria.observable: On the object host, a buffered-door event with no profile, reset between the behaviour capture's admission and the outcome's, has NO outcome record after the alarm (today: one, because the re-decision tests undefined while the loaded state is null); the session host unchanged.
